entities.name: Cell selection
entities.description: Procedure performed by the UE according to 3GPP TS 36.304 for selecting a suitable cell.

entities.name: Attach for emergency bearer services
entities.description: Optional procedure where the UE may initiate attach specifically for emergency bearer services.

entities.name: Attach for access to RLOS
entities.description: Optional procedure where the UE may initiate attach for access to RLOS (Restricted Local Operator Services).

entities.name: NO-IMSI condition
entities.description: Condition where the UE has no valid IMSI available.

relations.description: When in NO-IMSI condition, the UE shall perform cell selection.
When in NO-IMSI condition, the UE may optionally initiate attach for emergency bearer services.
When in NO-IMSI condition, the UE may optionally initiate attach for access to RLOS.
